subject: Medinex: stepwise payment lane (Net30→Net45) and VAT routing — request
messages:
From: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medinex.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payments@medinex.com
Date: 2025-11-02 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: pilot payment terms adjustment + VAT routing

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot looks promising. Finance asked me to check whether Redwood can accept a short-term change to our payment window for the pilot invoices. Specifically: can we move the first two invoices to Net45 instead of Net30 (to align with our month-end AR runs) and revert to Net30 after that?

A couple of details from our side:
- We will provide a signed PO (attached) and the company VAT certificate for EU processing.
- Can Redwood increase the initial credit hold to €50,000 to cover usage spikes during pilot ramp? We understand this is temporary and will be reconciled monthly.
- If you need any extra tax evidence (VAT registration number, legal entity docs) we can send them.

Goal is to get the contracts team comfortable so we can start provisioning next week. Let me know what you need from Redwood.

Thanks,
Luca
Finance Operations | Medinex
attachments: Medinex_PO_12345.pdf, Medinex_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medinex.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-02 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: pilot payment terms adjustment + VAT routing

Hi Luca — appreciated, and congrats on getting the PO in place. Quick read-through below and a few questions so we can route to finance and legal: 

Thanks for the attachments — I see the PO and the VAT cert. A couple of clarifying points before I get formal approval:
- Is the Net45 request strictly for the first two invoices (e.g., Month 0 and Month 1 usage), and then Net30 thereafter? Please confirm the exact invoice dates you expect.
- The €50k credit buffer: is that a soft cap you want Redwood to hold (we’d close out consumption monthly), or are you asking for a formal increase to the credit limit on the contract for the pilot period?
- VAT routing: do you need Redwood to issue invoices to the EU entity (Medinex BV) or the global HQ? We need the invoice entity to match the VAT docs to avoid cross-border VAT reallocation.

If you confirm those, I’ll get Finance/Legal looped and propose a short amendment (pilot addendum) — we typically handle this as a temporary payment schedule with a PO-backed credit buffer.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-03 10:21:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Medinex pilot payment terms — quick finance check

Irene — forwarding Luca’s ask. Finance note for context: temporary Net45 for first two invoices is acceptable for pilots if there is a PO and VAT evidence, provided we record a formal addendum and the credit buffer is treated as a monthly reconciliation (not a long-term credit increase).

Questions for you:
- Will we require a pre-authorized payment method/CC on file as additional guardrail or will the PO + monthly reconciliation suffice?
- If the customer wants a formal credit limit bump in the system, Finance needs a signed contract amendment and an explicit reconciliation cadence. Otherwise we can mark the buffer as ‘PO-backed temporary credit’ in the ledger.

I can sign off on the temporary Net45 once we have the PO + VAT cert and confirm invoice entity. —Marissa

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medinex.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-04 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: pilot payment terms adjustment + VAT routing

Thanks for confirming quickly, Luca. A couple of points pulled together from Finance:
1) Net45 for invoice #1 (issue date 2025-11-15) and invoice #2 (issue date 2025-12-15) only — invoices revert to Net30 beginning 2026-01-15.
2) We will accept the €50,000 buffer as a PO-backed temporary credit hold; this will be reconciled monthly against actual consumption. That means we won’t change contract credit limits in the system — it’ll be an addendum term stating the buffer and reconciliation cadence.
3) Invoice entity must match the VAT cert: please confirm the billing entity on the PO (company name + VAT ID) and we will bill that entity to avoid cross-border VAT complications.
4) As an extra guardrail, Finance requests a primary payment method on file (card or wire instructions) to enable faster remediation if the buffer is consumed ahead of schedule. This can be kept inactive unless needed.

If that looks good, I’ll prepare a short pilot addendum and send back for signature (we can use DocuSign). Once signed, we’ll provision Dedicated pilot capacity.

Best,
Irene

From: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medinex.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payments@medinex.com
Date: 2025-11-06 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: pilot payment terms adjustment + VAT routing

Irene / Marissa — this looks good and I appreciate the clarity. Confirmations from our side:
- Yes, Net45 for invoices dated 2025-11-15 and 2025-12-15, reverting to Net30 on 2026-01-15.
- The PO is issued to Medinex BV, VAT ID NL123456789.
- We’ll send bank wire instructions for the primary payment method to your secure channel; accounts-payments@medinex.com will follow up with needed docs.
- We accept the pilot addendum flow and DocuSign.

Please send the addendum and DocuSign link; we’ll get that signed today so provisioning can proceed.

Thanks — Luca
Medinex Finance Operations
attachments: Medinex_VAT_certificate.pdf
